en: Sepia-toned photograph of an ornate interior hall in Art Deco or late Beaux-Arts style, likely a grand lobby or ceremonial room. The space features a coffered ceiling with elaborate hanging light fixtures connected by chains, marble-clad walls with decorative panels and pilasters, and a central wooden door at the far end framed by rich ornament. The perspective is centered down the length of the hall, emphasizing symmetry. A small printed number "301" appears in the lower right corner, typical of series postcards.
